status: Completed; signed ARM64 APK assembled and verified

youtube: Bookmarks lists only saved videos using the host89 videos.query videos filter, applied before pagination. Existing channels remain in Channels and backups. Bookmark addition is disabled on non-video pages.
Tapping the current panel icon closes it; tapping another switches panels; Home closes panels and navigates home. Drawer titles are History and Bookmarks.
Explicit message-video playback clears mute/defaultMute and restores video/player volume before playback, including a video that is already playing muted. A later manual mute is preserved.
messages: Video attachments have a play icon plus Video button immediately beneath their thumbnail. Audio and YouTube play buttons use the same contrasting theme-aware treatment.
Button/background colors are chosen from theme pairs for contrast against the actual bubble base; text/icon contrast is at least4.5.
podcasts: Feed reads allow bounded16MiB documents, longer feed network time and64KiB read chunks. Public HTTP enclosure/redirect addresses are upgraded to TLS before any connection.
Podcast audio has its own resolver supporting12 public TLS hops with a30-second total deadline and10-second per-hop timeout; it no longer uses the shorter radio redirect limit.

Podcast decoding probes initial headers and supports Last-Modified or validated-length206 reads without requiring an ETag. Servers ignoring Range can use a bounded prefix skip. Redirects remain denied inside the decoder and every read retains permission checks.
Ordinary playback no longer depends on applying optional playback-rate settings.

sdk.native: Linux/main/diagnostic ARM64 match source;16KiB alignment verified
sdk.packages: All affected signed apps rebuilt with original publisher identity

checks.javascript: Production ad/metadata/autoplay/viewport scripts passed, including explicit unmute and later manual mute
checks.public_sources: Four real publisher feeds passed the Android parser. Four enclosures reached audio/mpeg206 responses. Servers with Last-Modified-only and no validators were observed.

limits: Actual Samsung decoding, speaker output and live YouTube behavior remain unverified.
Public source outages, premium/sign-in-only episodes and unsupported formats can still fail.
